benchmark_population: Same reporting year and property use; compliant, not demolished, positive weather-normalized EUI. Fixed reference across narrower dashboard filters. Percentile uses strictly lower observations; ties share a rank.
continuous_cohort_definition: Eligible in all six reporting years 2019–2024 and same reported property use in every year. No causal efficiency claim.
limitations: 2024 is a deliberate analysis year; 2025 records exist and finalization is unverified.
Weather-normalized EUI is nonadditive. No modeled savings, retrofit ROI, or causal effect is claimed.
GHG figures are partial sums of nonnegative reported compliant records, not citywide emissions estimates.
Changing or unknown reported property uses can remove buildings from matched cohorts. Peer group controls only for reported property use and year, not all building characteristics.
No outlier winsorization or hidden imputation. Eligibility excludes nonpositive EUI but does not certify remaining measurements as accurate.
